verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of OneDrive team activity or audit logs, an audit-log API, or SIEM export. The closest items are Graph delta queries, change notifications and file version history. These are developer change-tracking primitives and file history, not auditable activity logs, so they earn no credit. Audit logging is a fair axis for an enterprise file-storage product, so the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As a security engineer, activity is auditable — team event/audit logs with documented API access or SIEM export
